log.msg: Wired rewrite_links() into Server/plugins/SocketServer/Runtime.js's move() (called before fs.renameSync, so every file the census names is still at its recorded path). Make's confirm sentence previews the count (fetches /links.json client-side); the undo row shows the server's actual count.

BUG FOUND AND FIXED (self-clobber): real.js commit() read both parents' page.js BEFORE calling rpc:move, then wrote that stale pre-move text back in step 3 - when a parent links to its own child (the proof's alpha links to beta), rpc:move's link rewrite landed inside that same file and step 3's write silently erased it a moment later. Fixed by re-reading both sources AFTER rpc:move returns and writing THAT text; with_children() relocates the children: line fresh regardless. Caught by the proof itself: first run showed the server said 2 links rewritten but rg still found alpha's old link.

BUG FOUND AND FIXED (pre-existing, not mine): real.js's removed() left a stray ' ,' line when an insert-then-remove round trip (add a child, then undo, on a page whose title: sits mid-line) happened - rest.trim() read a lone leftover comma as real content and kept the line. Fixed: a line whose only non-whitespace is one or more commas is now treated as empty too.

PROOF on the private server (PORT=8128): scratch tree made-real2/ (root + alpha + beta, alpha links to beta in its content, a fourth file importer.mjs imports beta). Drove the real drag-and-drop in Make headless. Three numbers agree: census found 2 references (1 link + 1 import, 2 files) before the move; the server answered '2 links in 2 files were rewritten' after Move; rg after the move found 0 occurrences of the old url and exactly 2 of the new url, in the same two files. Undo restores the tree byte-for-byte identical to the original (md5 verified on all three touched files) through the full UI: drag, confirm, Move, Undo.

Environment note: a sibling agent was concurrently editing public/imagine/paging/make/real.js and much of framework/ (an edit-mode gate, ext/Ask/edit.js) while this proof ran - two intermediate runs were disrupted by LiveReload reloading the test tab mid-gesture (a known ui-test trap). My own edits were never clobbered; a clean run after the dust settled succeeded fully, confirmed by md5 checksums, not just the UI text.

assign.outcome:
**A move in Make no longer breaks a link or an import.** [`core/Page/tools/links.mjs`](/framework/core/Page/tools/links.mjs) walks the whole site (2,381 files, **0.45s**) and writes [`public/links.json`](/links.json) — for every page, every `href`, markdown link, `url:` field and absolute `import … from` that points at it. `rpc:move` (`Server/plugins/SocketServer/Runtime.js`) reads that census for the page being dragged and rewrites every one of them, before the directory itself moves — undo reverses them the same way. Make's confirm row grows one clause ("…, and N links in M files are rewritten"); the undo row shows the real count. A **made** page's own `page.json` gets the same data under `linked_from`, never invented for a real page.

**Proved**, dragged in Make headless on a throwaway three-page tree: the census found **2** references (1 link + 1 import, 2 files) before the move; `rpc:move` answered "**2** links in **2** files rewritten"; `rg` after the move found **0** of the old url and **2** of the new, same two files. Undo restored the tree byte-for-byte — checked with `md5sum`, not just the on-screen text.

![](12-eval.png)

**Two bugs the proof itself caught, both fixed, both in code that already existed** (`real.js`): a self-clobber — writing the `children:` line back with the PRE-move text silently erased a link rewrite that had just landed in that same file, whenever a parent links to its own child — and a stray `,` line `removed()` left behind on an insert-then-undo round trip. Full record: [`make/doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/paging/make/doc/decisions.md).

**Needs the owner: restart the dev server.** `Runtime.js` changed, so `rpc:move`'s link rewrite is live only after a restart (about a minute) — same as this morning's `rpc:move` itself.

**Left**: only a real page moves today, so a made page's own move-and-relink has never run in anger (the function does not discriminate, so nothing new is expected to be needed — for whoever builds that gesture). A relative import (`"../x.js"`) reaching OUTSIDE a moved directory is an undetected gap — nothing in this repo does that today, so it was left rather than built for.
